metadata.name: thawgate_gate
metadata.description: ThawGate: Token ACL (sRFC 37) gating program with issuer blacklist, allowlist and SAS KYC policies

instructions.name: can_freeze_permissionless
docs: Token ACL gate interface: may this token account be frozen permissionlessly?

instructions.name: can_thaw_permissionless
docs: Token ACL gate interface: may this token account be thawed permissionlessly?

instructions.name: init_policy
docs: Creates the mint's policy and its thaw/freeze extra-metas lists.
Signed by the Token ACL freeze authority; `args.authority` becomes the policy admin.

accounts.name: freeze_authority
docs: Token ACL `MintConfig.freeze_authority` of this mint. Can be a PDA signing through CPI
(the sss-token config in S6). The policy admin is `args.authority`, which may be someone else.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent. Separate from `freeze_authority`, since a program-owned PDA cannot fund `create_account`.

instructions.name: setup_extra_metas
docs: Rewrites both extra-metas lists from the stored policy (idempotent).

instructions.name: update_policy
docs: Changes the policy and rewrites both extra-metas lists to match.

errors.name: InvalidMintConfig
errors.msg: Not a Token ACL MintConfig (owner, size or discriminator)

errors.name: MintConfigMismatch
errors.msg: The MintConfig belongs to a different mint

errors.name: NotFreezeAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the Token ACL freeze authority of this mint

errors.name: NotPolicyAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the policy authority

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Mint is not a Token-2022 mint

errors.name: InvalidExtraMetasAccount
errors.msg: Extra-metas account is not the expected PDA

errors.name: MissingIssuerProgram
errors.msg: issuer_program must be set when the blacklist or allowlist is enabled

errors.name: MissingSasConfig
errors.msg: sas_credential and sas_schema must be set when require_sas is on

errors.name: BypassNeedsSas
errors.msg: BypassForPdas stands in for the SAS credential, so it needs require_sas

errors.name: DeniedMissingAccounts
errors.msg: TG:DENY:MISSING_ACCOUNTS: extra accounts missing

errors.name: DeniedBadPolicy
errors.msg: TG:DENY:BAD_POLICY: policy account is not this mint's GatePolicy

errors.name: DeniedBadRegistryEntry
errors.msg: TG:DENY:BAD_REGISTRY_ENTRY: registry account has the wrong owner, type or fields

errors.name: DeniedBadCredential
errors.msg: TG:DENY:BAD_CREDENTIAL: attestation account is not a SAS attestation of this credential, schema and owner

errors.name: DeniedNoImmutableOwner
errors.msg: TG:DENY:NO_IMMUTABLE_OWNER: token account lacks the ImmutableOwner extension

errors.name: DeniedBlacklisted
errors.msg: TG:DENY:BLACKLISTED: owner is on the issuer blacklist

errors.name: DeniedNotAllowlisted
errors.msg: TG:DENY:NOT_ALLOWLISTED: owner is not on the issuer allowlist

errors.name: DeniedNoCredential
errors.msg: TG:DENY:NO_CREDENTIAL: owner has no SAS attestation (never issued, or revoked)

errors.name: DeniedCredentialExpired
errors.msg: TG:DENY:CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED: owner's SAS attestation has expired

errors.name: DeniedKycLevelTooLow
errors.msg: TG:DENY:KYC_LEVEL_TOO_LOW: owner's kyc_level is below the policy minimum

errors.name: DeniedCompliant
errors.msg: TG:DENY:COMPLIANT: owner passes the policy, so it cannot be frozen permissionlessly

types.name: AllowlistMode
docs: How the issuer allowlist is used.

types.name: GatePolicy
docs: One per mint. Token ACL resolves it for the gate as extra account `[6]`.

fields.name: authority
docs: May change the policy (`update_policy`, `setup_extra_metas`).

fields.name: issuer_program
docs: Program that owns the registry (sss-token): `BlacklistEntry` at `["blacklist", mint, wallet]`,
`AllowlistEntry` at `["allowlist", mint, wallet]`.

fields.name: require_sas
docs: SAS KYC policy: the owner needs a live attestation at `["attestation", sas_credential, sas_schema, owner]`
under SAS (nonce = holder wallet).

fields.name: min_kyc_level
docs: 0 = any level. Otherwise compared with the attestation data's first byte, so the schema's first field must
be `kyc_level: u8`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for later policies (sanctions, keeper settings) without a realloc.

types.name: PolicyArgs
docs: Settable policy fields, for `init_policy` and `update_policy`.
